questions.question: Which sport is played with a racket and a small, hard ball that is hit over a net?
questions.explanation: Tennis is played with a racket, hitting the ball over a net into the opponent's court. The other sports mentioned either do not use a racket or have different rules and equipment.

questions.question: Which chess piece can move diagonally across the board and is one of the strongest pieces in the game?
questions.explanation: The bishop can move diagonally across any number of squares and plays a central role in controlling the chessboard. However, unlike other pieces, it has access only to squares of its own color.

questions.question: What is a key component of the opening ceremony of the Olympic Games?
choices: B: The closing speech of the IOC President
C: The lighting of the Olympic flame
D: The competition of the athletes
questions.explanation: The lighting of the Olympic flame is a central symbol of the Olympic Games and marks the beginning of the competitions. This tradition dates back to the ancient Olympic Games and is celebrated at every opening ceremony.

questions.question: What is the main rule to be observed at the start of a race to avoid a false start?
choices: A: Athletes must start with one leg forward.
B: Athletes must not cross the starting line before the shot.
C: All athletes must hear the starting shot simultaneously.
D: Athletes must place their feet in a specific position.
questions.explanation: A false start is penalized when an athlete crosses the starting line before the starting shot. This rule ensures a fair and even start to the competition.

questions.question: Which of the following principles is fundamental to the concept of Fair Play at the Olympic Games?
choices: A: Compliance with doping ban regulations.
B: Increasing the number of medals for the most successful nations.
D: Conducting competitions in a closed room.
questions.explanation: Fair Play involves athletes respecting the rules of the sport, including doping bans, which aim to ensure fair competition conditions. This is a central element of Olympic ethics and contributes to the integrity of the Games.

questions.question: Which belt is the highest rank in most martial arts?
questions.explanation: In many martial arts, such as Judo or Karate, the black belt is the highest rank achieved by experts. It symbolizes not only skills but also knowledge and experience in the respective martial art. The black belt is often complemented by a variety of colors and gradations, but it remains the central indicator of high competence.

questions.question: Which athlete set a world record in the 100-meter dash in 2009, which still stands as one of the fastest in history?
questions.explanation: Usain Bolt ran the 100 meters in 9.58 seconds in 2009, setting a new world record. This record is considered one of the most impressive in the history of athletics and has not been surpassed to this day.

questions.question: Which sports equipment is commonly used in tennis?
questions.explanation: In tennis, a tennis racket is used to hit the ball. This equipment is specifically designed for the requirements of the game and is distinct from equipment used in other sports like badminton or volleyball.

questions.question: What is the nickname of the German national football team?
questions.explanation: The nickname 'Die Mannschaft' is frequently used to refer to the German national team. This name gained popularity, especially after winning the 2014 World Cup, and symbolizes the team spirit and unity among the players.

questions.question: Which of the following sports was originally part of the Ancient Olympic Games?
questions.explanation: Wrestling is one of the oldest sports in the Olympic Games and was already present at the first games in 776 BC. It is considered a central element of ancient sports culture and was closely linked to the development of combat skills.

questions.question: How many players are active on the field per team during a handball game?
questions.explanation: In handball, seven players (6 field players and 1 goalkeeper) are active on the field per team. This rule is fundamental to the game and influences the tactics and playing system of the teams.

questions.question: How many players are usually on the field in a handball team per team?
questions.explanation: In a handball game, there are seven players per team on the field (six field players and one goalkeeper). This format allows for a fast and dynamic game that requires both tactics and teamwork.

questions.question: Which winter sport is practiced on a slope covered with snow, where athletes stand on a board and try to pass through gates?
questions.explanation: Skiing is one of the most well-known winter sports, where athletes ski down a slope and navigate controlled through gates. It is a popular discipline practiced both recreationally and competitively.

questions.question: Welches Land war Gastgeber der Fußball-Weltmeisterschaft 2018?
questions.explanation: Die Fußball-Weltmeisterschaft 2018 fand in Russland statt und war die erste WM, die in Osteuropa ausgetragen wurde. Frankreich gewann das Turnier und sicherte sich seinen zweiten Weltmeistertitel.
